uplink.description: Status report: 3.0 V, contact closed, 125.0 mA loop current, 6.657 V ADC
uplink._note: TTN example status report (netvox r718ijk codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Upstream oracle: Volt 3, Status 1, Current 100, ADCRaw 6657, FineCurrent 25. byte3 0x1E=30 -> 3.0 V; byte4=1 -> contactState 'closed'; byte5=100 + byte8=250 (0.1 mA -> 25.0) -> analog.current 125.0 mA; bytes[6..7]=0x1A01=6657 mV -> adcVoltage 6.657 V. (Illustrative upstream values; the codec applies the documented split-field and mV scaling.)
